name: Sceleritas Fel
backstory:
__NOTOC__

Sceleritas Fel is a Fiend in Baldur's Gate 3 integral to The Dark Urge's past. While he himself encourages his master towards evil, the Dark Urge can be resisted. He only appears within a Dark Urge playthrough, or if The Dark Urge is within a Multiplayer party.
voice_hint: butler of bhaal (voiced by Brian Bowles)
